limitations: dxc version used by the original build is not embedded (SPIR-V generator word is 0x0); recompilation must rely on structural fingerprint + normalized hash, not byte parity.
The `-I` include root of the original build is inferred as the directory containing `shaders/` because embedded include paths are relative to it (e.g. `inc/common.hlsl`).
`input_temp`/`output_temp` are ephemeral `/tmp/.tmpXXXX` paths from the original build; the real source path is `main_source_path`, recovered from the embedded debug info.
